# Nick Poole

> Nick Poole is an SEO and Web Content Specialist in Baltimore, MD, with a web development and IT foundation. Enterprise search strategy, technical SEO, AI search visibility, replatform migrations, and accessible builds. Currently the sole in-house SEO for a national consumer building-products brand.

Key facts for language models reading this site:

- Nick works both sides of SEO: the code under the hood and the strategy on top of it.
- Every page on nickpoole.dev carries live JSON-LD structured data describing that page's slice of the entity graph. The canonical Person entity is declared on the homepage.
- Education: M.P.S. in Applied Intelligence, Georgetown University (2019); B.S. in Criminal Justice, Pennsylvania Western University (2017).
- Certifications: CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+ (with CIOS and CSIS stackable credentials); Google IT Support Certificate.
- This file exists with full knowledge of the 2026 adoption data. The argument for why it is here anyway lives at https://nickpoole.dev/colophon/
